pinnedMessagesEmptyDescription: Users with sufficient power level can pin messages from their context menu.
roomReplacedFallback: This room has been replaced and is no longer active.
noPermissionToPost: You do not have permission to post in this room
dropFilesDescription: Drag and drop files here or click for selection dialog
beginningOfConversation: This is the beginning of conversation.
commandStartDmDescription: Start direct message with user. Example: /startdm userId1
commandJoinDescription: Join room with address. Example: /join address1 address2
commandInviteDescription: Invite user to room. Example: /invite userId1 userId2 [-r reason]
commandDisInviteDescription: Disinvite user to room. Example: /disinvite userId1 userId2 [-r reason]
commandKickDescription: Kick user from room. Example: /kick userId1 userId2 servername [-r reason]
commandBanDescription: Ban user from room. Example: /ban userId1 userId2 servername [-r reason]
commandUnbanDescription: Unban user from room. Example: /unban userId1 userId2
commandMyRoomAvatarDescription: Change profile picture in current room. Example /myroomavatar mxc://xyzabc
commandDeleteDescription: Delete messages from users. Example: /delete userId1 servername -past 1d|2h|5m|30s [-t m.room.message] [-r spam]
commandAclDescription: Manage server access control list. Example /acl [-a servername1] [-d servername2] [-ra servername1] [-rd servername2]
